eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Five
subtitle: Lesson 47 · Data Types, Strings, and Dates

code:
SELECT LTRIM('   Hello') AS LeftTrimmed;   -- 'Hello'
SELECT RTRIM('Hello   ') AS RightTrimmed;  -- 'Hello'
caption: LTRIM strips leading spaces; RTRIM strips trailing ones. Neither touches the middle.
The modern, cleaner way to remove both sides in one call.

code:
